category_title: At-risk dyscalculic pupils with core deficits in representing and processing numerosity
scenario_title: Distraction and guessing during initial counting demonstration
minimal_context: David is sitting in a one-on-one remedial setting and is asked to identify the number of pips on a domino card.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Good morning. Here are some domino cards. Let's look at the dots on this one.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Morning... (He nods his head, looking shy and nervous, and looks at the ground.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please tell me how many dots are on the card.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Eight. (He stared at the mathematics domino cards.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Good morning. Here are some domino cards. Let's look at the dots on this one.

STUDENT: Morning... (He nods his head, looking shy and nervous, and looks at the ground.)

TUTOR: Please tell me how many dots are on the card.

STUDENT: Eight. (He stared at the mathematics domino cards.)

TUTOR: How do you know?

STUDENT: I saw it.

task.content: Identifying the number of pips on a domino card

context.time_context: Beginning of the first remedial lesson

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: During teacher's demonstration of how to count the pips on domino cards
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: He looks at the ground, then stared at the mathematics domino cards and guessed the number without counting

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked 'How do you know?' after stating a number
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Responds by saying he just saw it, lacking a counting strategy
